# Deep links

A deep link opens a view of AgentMux at a place inside it: a Settings section, a Kanban task, a file at a line.
Every link has the same form:

```
agentmux://view[/place][?key=value&…][#anchor]
```

- Every part is an id, never a label, so a renamed label does not break a link.
- A link has one written form: lower-case ids, upper-case percent-encoding, parameters in the order shown here, no trailing slash.
- A link is at most 512 bytes, is percent-decoded once, and names each parameter once.
- A link never names a pane, tab or window, and never opens a connection.
- A link with a view, place or parameter this AgentMux does not have is refused with the reason, never partly opened.

Agents open the same places with the `Pane` tool's `open` action and a `link`.

## Settings (`settings`)

Agents: yes. Surfaces: desktop.

| Link | Opens |
|---|---|
| `agentmux://settings` | Settings |
| `agentmux://settings/<section>?board=<slug>#<id>` | `appearance` (Appearance), `animations` (Animations), `window` (Window & Panes), `browser` (Browser), `terminal` (Terminal), `keyboard` (Keyboard shortcuts), `sounds` (Sounds), `notifications` (Notifications & Tray), `recording` (Recording), `devices` (Paired devices), `widgets` (Widgets), `agents` (Agents), `kanban` (Kanban), `advanced` (Advanced) |
